description: This file implements a usage logger class for PySpark pandas, providing methods to log success, failure, and missing/deprecated function calls using Python's logging library.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkUsageLogger
classes.description: A class that provides methods to log usage events (success, failure, missing/deprecated) for functions and properties in PySpark pandas.

methods.name: _format_signature
methods.description: Formats a Signature object into a string representing the function signature.

methods.name: PandasOnSparkUsageLogger.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the logger instance with a specific logger name.

methods.name: PandasOnSparkUsageLogger.log_success
methods.description: Logs a successful function or property call with duration.

methods.name: PandasOnSparkUsageLogger.log_failure
methods.description: Logs a failed function or property call with exception and duration.

methods.name: PandasOnSparkUsageLogger.log_missing
methods.description: Logs a call to a missing or deprecated function or property.
